name: 1st-stack
description: A full-stack Lean app (Lasm.RPC, Lasm.Fetch, Lasm.UI), compiled to WebAssembly by Lasm

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:workers: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target workers
scripts.build:bun: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target bun
scripts.build:deno: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target deno
scripts.build:vercel-edge: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target vercel-edge
scripts.build:netlify-edge: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target netlify-edge
scripts.build:deno-deploy: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target deno-deploy
scripts.build:fastly: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target fastly
scripts.build:wasi-http: npm run build:client && lasm build Server.lean --target wasi-http
